title: HELIX Terminology: Expense Report Status
description: Status of employee expense reimbursement requests in the travel and expense system.

codes.definition: Expense report started but not yet submitted. Employee is adding receipts, coding expenses to chartfields, and calculating mileage or per diem amounts.
Expense report submitted for approval. Routing to the appropriate approver(s) based on institutional travel policy and delegation of authority.
Under review by one or more approvers. May require department head, PI (for grant-funded travel), and/or dean approval depending on dollar amount and funding source.
All required approvals obtained. Routed to accounts payable/travel office for audit and payment processing.

Reimbursement issued to the employee via direct deposit or check. Typically processed within 5-10 business days of final approval. Grant-funded travel may take longer due to additional compliance review.
Report sent back to the submitter due to issues: missing receipts, incorrect account coding, policy violations (exceeded per diem, unauthorized expenses), or missing pre-trip authorization.

Expense report rejected. Common reasons: expense not allowable per policy, insufficient documentation, travel not pre-approved, exceeds budget authority, or retroactive request beyond the submission deadline (typically 30-60 days).

Report flagged for detailed review by the travel office or internal audit. May be random selection, high-dollar threshold, or triggered by anomaly detection. Employee may need to provide additional documentation.
